title: LinkedIn Insight tag behind consent
description:
As the site owner, I want LinkedIn conversion tracking only if LinkedIn ads start, and only after consent.

Blocked until LinkedIn ads start.

LinkedIn Insight has no Consent Mode integration, so the tag must load only after the visitor presses Accept. Update the privacy policy first.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: No tag before consent
  Given a visitor has not accepted
  Then no LinkedIn request is made and no LinkedIn cookie is set
Scenario: Tag after Accept
  Given a visitor presses Accept
  Then the Insight tag loads
Scenario: Policy first
  Given the privacy policy mentions LinkedIn
  Then it was published before the tag was added

Dependencies: blocked-by consent banner issue.
